en: A vintage black-and-white postcard with a dark background. Across the center is the large word "TROLLHÄTTAN" in stylized, wavy block letters. Each letter is filled with small photographic scenes, likely showing various views of the city: churches, streets, buildings, waterways, bridges, ships, and surrounding landscapes. There is no other visible text or border decoration.
